caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Rise
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing 24 kt winds with 5.9 ft wave heights and a 62% rain probability, while Martinique has 13 kt winds. I expect the Western Caribbean to see the most significant impacts, particularly around Roatan, due to these conditions.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Cadiz
mediterranean.paragraph: Cadiz in the Western Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 11 kt and seas building to 2.7 ft with W swell at 8s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
